title: Life
author: Akshaya Kumar Das
text:
Life brings new surprises,
Unravelling more mysteries & craziness,

That gives tons of inspiration,
Soul flies to the clouds in oblivion,

Poetry , singing & art my food for thought,
Love to embrace the trio my most sought,

Life is proving to be sheer miracle,
Hope piling up with the beauty of oracles,

Living life to the fullest,
The dream comes true & best,

Life is an enigmatic journey of surprises,
As age climbs up the surprises just unleash,

To amaze my mundanely existence in this material universe,
Every day I dream to create a wonderful verse,

My voice my wishes turn into fantom verses,
I just love to singout my heart to the vast universe,

My miniature existence in a mass universe,
